input.document_text: Warranty Claim Registration. Equipment: Voltas 1.8 Ton Window AC (Model 183 DZA). Customer: Ramesh Pillay. Purchase Date: 2024-08-02. Warranty: 2 years comprehensive. Warranty Expiry: 2026-08-02. Claim Raised: 2026-03-14. Remaining Warranty: 141 days. Problem: AC not cooling — room temperature remains 30°C despite running for 2 hours. Technician Diagnosis: Low refrigerant gas, likely small leak in evaporator coil. Parts Required: Evaporator coil replacement and gas recharge.
